result.summary: The new SSRF check has a reproducible cloud-metadata bypass. Selected tests: 46 passed; two were blocked by the read-only environment.

findings.title: Alternate numeric IP notation bypasses metadata SSRF protection
findings.body: InstanceConfig(url="http://0xa9fea9fe", enabled=True) passes the new validator. The delegated helper treats this hostname as DNS after ipaddress.ip_address rejects it (triggarr/web/validation.py:153–174), but socket.getaddrinfo with AI_NUMERICHOST resolves it to 169.254.169.254; HTTPX preserves the numeric hostname. Startup passes the accepted URL to the client at triggarr/startup.py:155, which sends a request at triggarr/clients/base.py:216. Thus the new check fails to block the metadata destination it explicitly targets, without requiring DNS rebinding. Actual network reachability depends on deployment egress controls.
findings.recommendation: Normalize or reject alternative numeric IPv4 representations before applying address restrictions. Add model-level regression tests for hexadecimal, decimal-integer, and octal representations of blocked addresses.

next_steps: Close the numeric-address bypass and rerun configuration and validation tests in a writable test environment.
